content.title: Who Is Noah Kahan's Wife? All About Brenna, Who Is Featured in His Netflix Documentary
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Noah Kahan has known his wife, Brenna, for well over a decadeThe couple got engaged in 2023 and married in 2025Brenna is featured in the singer's Netflix documentary, Noah Kahan: Out of Body Noah Kahan's wife is supportive of his music career. The "Stick Season" singer has known his wife, Brenna, for well over a decade, as he referenced her on Instagram as early as 2014. The pair have largely kept their relationship out of the spotlight but have made a few public appearances together, including the TIME 100 Gala in 2023 and again at the 2025 Grammy Awards. After several years of dating, Kahan and Brenna got engaged in July 2023. They got married in Vermont in August 2025, his rep confirmed to PEOPLE that September. On April 13, fans got a closer look at the musician's life in his Netflix documentary, Noah Kahan: Out of Body, which saw him open up about navigating fame and his mental health struggles over the years. It also featured his wife, who said that she "never doubted Noah." "I always knew you had it in you to make music a career for yourself," Brenna told Kahan in the documentary. So, who is Noah Kahan’s wife? Here’s what to know about Brenna and her relationship with the musician. Kahan and Brenna have known each other for over a decade Noah Kahan and Brenna attend the 2023 TIME100 Next Gala on Oct. 24, 2023 in New York City. Craig Barritt/Getty While the "Dial Drunk" singer has not publicly shared how long he has known Brenna, she first appeared on the artist's Instagram in 2014. The post, which was simply captioned, "#tbt," featured a photo of Brenna as a child sitting on an outdoor chair. Kahan and Brenna have lived in several different places together throughout their relationship, including Boston, Nashville and back in their home state of Vermont, as shared in Noah Kahan: Out of Body. They got engaged in July 2023 and married two years later Noah Kahan attends the 66th GRAMMY Awards at Crypto.com Arena on Feb. 4, 2024. Neilson Barnard/Getty As Kahan shared in his documentary, he and Brenna got engaged during a trip to Cabo on July 17, 2023. The singer not only referred to Brenna as his "greatest trophy," but also called their engagement day "one of the best days of my life." The couple got married on Aug. 23, 2025, in an "intimate ceremony in their home state of Vermont," Kahan's rep confirmed to PEOPLE that September. He wrote a note to her in the dedication of his Stick Season vinyl Noah Kahan and Brenna attend the 67th Annual GRAMMY Awards on Feb. 2, 2025, in Los Angeles. Kevin Mazur/Getty In the dedication of his Stick Season (We’ll All Be Here Forever) vinyl, which was released in April 2024, Kahan included a message to Brenna. “To my fiancée, you're the air I breathe, you are everything and whatever is left after that,” he wrote in the dedication. “I could spend the rest of my life thanking you for getting me through this, and I promise I will. I love you to the moon and back." Brenna has supported Kahan’s journey as a musician Noah Kahan performs during 2023 Austin City Limits Music Festival at Zilker Park on Oct. 14, 2023 in Austin, Texas. Erika Goldring/FilmMagic In Noah Kahan: Out of Body, Brenna said she "always had a feeling" and "never doubted" Kahan's ability to turn music into a career for himself. Since skyrocketing to fame, she has supported the "Forever" singer's career, joining him at the Grammys and attending his shows. In October 2024, Kahan celebrated the end of his Stick Season era with an Instagram post thanking his loved ones for their support, including Brenna. “I was cheered on through it all by my fiancé, by my parents and siblings, my incredible band, my management and the extraordinary crew of folks who all gave 2.5 years of their life to this magical sequence of dreams, this spiral of hotel rooms and dark basements and cramped event center hallways,” he wrote in the caption. “I owe a great debt to all to them, I hope they can all feel my gratitude."
